transcript.content: Hello, I'm Dr. Smith. It's nice to meet you; what brings you in to see me today?

Hi, Dr. Smith. Well, I guess what made me finally ask for help is that I barely want to eat anymore. Like, I'll be on my lunch break at the store, just staring at food I used to really like, and... I just end up throwing most of it away. I just don't have an appetite.
When you look at yourself in the mirror, do you find yourself feeling dissatisfied with your body shape or weight?

No, it's not about that. I don't really have any issues with my weight or how my body looks in the mirror. It's not like I'm trying to diet or change my shape or anything like that... I just genuinely don't feel hungry.
Beyond the lack of appetite, have you been feeling persistently sad, down, or have you lost interest in activities you usually enjoy?

Yeah, I definitely have. I just don't care about the stuff I used to enjoy. Like, I used to get really excited about going to gallery nights, or playing basketball, even just grabbing food-truck tacos or... helping kids with art stuff. But lately, it's just... I don't know. If I do go, I just stand there feeling completely flat. I usually just end up making an excuse to leave.
Have you ever experienced a period like this before, where you felt this way for several weeks or longer?
No, I don't think so. I mean, everyone has bad days, but... I've never had anything last for weeks like this before. This is definitely the first time I've felt this stuck.
How has your sleep been lately?

It's been pretty bad, honestly. Most nights I just lie there... replaying this award thing and conversations from the store. And then, if I actually do manage to fall asleep, I end up waking up way too early. Once I'm up, I just can't get my mind to shut back off.
During the day, do you find yourself feeling physically restless and unable to sit still, or do you feel like your movements and speech have slowed down significantly?

I don't think I've really noticed either of those, honestly. I mean, I'm not pacing around or anything, but I don't feel like I'm moving in slow motion, either. I just feel... tired, I guess. But my body feels pretty normal.
How much has this been interfering with your ability to function at work or in your daily responsibilities?

I'm still going in to work, but... it's definitely affecting me there. I've been messing up the inventory counts and my display plans enough that my manager has actually had to start double-checking my work. 

And outside of the store, I've just been skipping things. I haven't been going to gallery nights or playing basketball, and... I used to show up for these youth art workshops, but I've been skipping those too. I just haven't had it in me.
